independent_event_oracle: YAML 1.2.2 specification (§5.1 Character Set [2] nb-json, §7.3.1 Double-Quoted Style [109] c-double-quoted); libyaml rejects U+007F DEL
cannot_use_independent_json_reason: libyaml cannot parse this fixture because it rejects U+007F (DEL) anywhere in the stream with ReaderError (unacceptable character #x007f: control characters are not allowed), whereas YAML 1.2.2 §5.1 ([2] nb-json) permits U+007F inside quoted scalars. In addition, JSON has no native tag syntax, so the .json golden encodes the local !COFF tag using ayaml's single-entry wrapper mapping ({"!COFF": ...}). The expected event stream and value are derived independently from YAML 1.2.2 and the upstream llvm-dlltool COFF symbol fixture.
